name: Kawajiri Madhouse noir (Prism anime_kawajiri_madhouse_90s), drawn by Krea2
lead: The image is a hand-painted 1990s cel animation frame in the Madhouse manner, with crisp, sharp black lines and angular anatomy with long tapered limbs, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes with large solid black masses, hard rim light on edges, airbrushed misty backgrounds and 35mm film grain, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of dark indigo, teal and charcoal night, with ochre and amber lamplight and blood-red and sickly green accents.

refs.lead: Hand-painted 1990s cel animation, as in Ninja Scroll: crisp sharp black lines, angular anatomy with long narrow faces, hard two-tone cel shading with large solid black shadow masses, hard rim light, dark indigo, teal and charcoal night with amber, blood-red and sickly green accents, airbrushed misty backgrounds, heavy film grain. Flat unblended colour on the figures, mature adult faces with narrow eyes, grainy celluloid texture.
refs.recap: Rendered throughout as hand-painted 1990s cel animation with large black shadow masses and heavy film grain.

characters.tags: Full-length front view at eye level, the lone figure centred from hat to boots against a plain dark indigo backdrop. Cold side light from the left, a hard amber rim light down the figure's right edge, the left half in solid black.

locations.tags: Wide establishing shot at eye level, the place empty of people, one hard light source.
